description:
Job Title: TS/SCI Cleared Java Developer

Position Overview:
We are seeking a skilled Java Developer with an active TS/SCI clearance to support mission-critical development efforts within a high-security federal environment. This role is ideal for candidates with 3+ years of experience who are looking to contribute to impactful, data-driven solutions supporting national geospatial initiatives.
The selected candidate will join a collaborative technical team responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable applications that enable advanced analysis and operational decision-making.

Required Qualifications:
Active TS/SCI clearance (required to start)
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
3+ years of professional Java development experience
Experience developing enterprise-level applications
Familiarity with object-oriented design principles
Experience working in Linux-based environments
Understanding of secure development practices

Responsibilities: 
Design, develop, test, and maintain Java-based applications in a secure enterprise environment
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including systems engineers, analysts, and architects
Develop RESTful services and backend components to support data-intensive workflows
Participate in Agile development activities including sprint planning, stand-ups, and code reviews
Troubleshoot and resolve performance, scalability, and integration issues
Support deployment and sustainment of applications within classified environments
Contribute to system documentation and technical design discussions

Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with Spring / Spring Boot
Familiarity with RESTful APIs and microservices architecture
Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
Exposure to cloud or hybrid environments
Experience working within the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency mission space or similar IC environments
Prior experience supporting classified federal programs

What You’ll Bring:
Strong problem-solving skills
Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment
Adaptability within mission-driven development efforts
Commitment to quality and secure coding standards

Clearance Requirement:
Active TS/SCI clearance required.
